The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Lemon squeezy

The restriction of platforms like Lemon Squeezy and Stripe in specific countries essentially blocks creators from monetizing their digital products. With Stripe operating in only 46 out of 195 countries, a large number of potential sellers are left without viable options. This exclusion not only stifles entrepreneurial spirit but also undermines the potential for economic growth in these regions. By offering a sovereign commerce infrastructure, we can empower creators to bypass these limitations and establish their own fully functional online stores.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Sovereign commerce infrastructure operates on a carefully constructed stack of free and accessible tools that ensure creators can sell directly without intermediaries. It uses platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, combined with backend logic handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. For payment processing, NOWPayments facilitates automatic crypto transactions, eliminating the need for traditional banks or payment processors that may impose restrictions. This architecture not only provides flexibility but also ensures that creators have complete control over their sales and customer data.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators who are often shut out of mainstream payment platforms due to geopolitical restrictions. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, or digital assets, this infrastructure allows you to operate without the fear of account suspensions or payment delays. By utilizing a decentralized approach to commerce, creators can engage with global audiences while retaining ownership of their business and the ability to scale as needed, free from the limitations imposed by traditional platforms.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers creators to bypass payment restrictions.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereign commerce stack is built from components that seamlessly integrate to create a cohesive selling environment. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the storefront, while Supabase or Google Sheets function as the order management system. File delivery is handled through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring that products are delivered instantly upon purchase. This stack is completed with NOWPayments, which allows for payment verification in over 300 cryptocurrencies. Together, these components provide a robust infrastructure that is both reliable and efficient.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To leverage this sovereign commerce infrastructure, start by selecting the appropriate stack for your needs—consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for a complete solution. Next, set up your hosting using Cloudflare Pages and configure your backend logic with Cloudflare Workers. Integrate Supabase for data management, and connect NOWPayments for payment processing. Finally, upload your digital products, test the system, and launch your store. For more detailed guidance, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Full ownership means no platform can freeze your funds or suspend your account.

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
